text:
harper: quick flag from the SDK rollout smoke: a few doc snippets still call `max_tokens` and some tool examples use the old `function_call` object. noticed this in deno and faiss pages.

jon: can you list the paths? i'll pick up the deno snippets.

harper: `docs/snippets/deno/generate.md`, `docs/guides/migrations/compatibility-notes.md` (code blocks), `docs/integrations/vector-stores/faiss.md` (embed dims + reindex note).

mei: i'll write a tiny jscodeshift/codemod and a Deno-focused README note. Deno users often copy/paste, so i'll include an explicit before/after example for the CLI.

jon: example i'll add in PR:
```js
// OLD
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', prompt, max_tokens: 128 })

// NEW
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', prompt, max_output_tokens: 128 })
```

kevin: on the FAISS side: rwd-2 embeddings were 1536; rwd-3-compat is 2048. if customers don't reindex they'll get a mismatch error when loading indexes. we should include a small python repro and a migration recipe (`dump -> re-embed -> reindex`). mark it as high impact.

mei: noted. i'll add a bold callout in the faiss doc and a tiny shell script: `python reembed.py --model rwd-3-compat --dir ./vectors` as a reproducible step.

harper: what deprecation timeline should we show in the docs banner? PM recommended a clear date so integrators have time.

jon: propose: "Support for legacy `max_tokens` and `function_call` removed 2026-08-15; update by 2026-07-15." i'll run that past PMs but it's a working draft.

release-bot: PRs opened: 8342 (deno snippets), 8343 (migration guide), 8344 (faiss). CI: lint passed, snippets smoke tests queued.

docs-linter: heads-up: changing parameter names may break anchors in the migration guide; please run `docs-linter check-anchors` before merging.

jon: i'll include a codemod link in the migration guide and run anchor checks in CI. aiming to merge within 48h.

kevin: after merge, ops: schedule a docs rebuild and post a short note to #customer-success with the reindex recipe. support should be on standby for first 72h.

harper: thanks folks. once merged i'll update the smoke harness to assert on `max_output_tokens` and `tool_calls[0]` for tool integrations.

(THREAD END)
